results.content: Science Fiction Writer Robert J. Sawyer: Nebula Winners for Best Novel (Chronological)(arindex.htm) Science Fiction Writer  ROBERT J. SAWYER  Hugo and Nebula Winner  ---   SFWRITER.COM > About Rob > Nebula Award > Winners (Chronological)     ---    Nebula Winners for Best Novel Here are all the winners of the Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers of America's Nebula Award for Best Novel of the Year, in chronological order. Nebulas are dated for the year of publication, which is the year before the year in which they are presented: the 1965 Nebula Award was bestowed in 1966.   ``` 1965 Dune Frank Herbert 1966 Flowers for Algernon (tie) Daniel Keyes 1966 Babel-17 (tie) Samuel R. results.title: Nebula Awards Nominees and Winners: Best Novel
results.content:
## 2022

   _Legends & Lattes_ by Travis Baldree, published by Cryptid and Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2022
   _Spear_ by Nicola Griffith, published by Tordotcom. Nominated for Best Novel in 2022
   _Nettle and Bone_ by T. Kingfisher, published by Tor and Titan UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2022
   _Babel_ by R. F. Kuang, published by Harper Voyager US and Harper Voyager UK. Winner, Best Novel in 2022
   _The Mountain in the Sea_ by Ray Nayler, published by MCD and Weidenfeld & Nicolson. Nominated for Best Novel in 2022
   _Nona the Ninth_ by Tamsyn Muir, published by Tordotcom. Nominated for Best Novel in 2022

## 2021

   _The Unbroken_ by C. L. Clark, published by Orbit US and Orbit UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2021
   _A Master of Djinn_ by P. Djèlí Clark, published by Tordotcom and Orbit UK. Winner, Best Novel in 2021
   _Machinehood_ by S.B. Divya, published by Saga. Nominated for Best Novel in 2021
   _A Desolation called Peace_ by Arkady Martine, published by Tor and Tor UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2021
   _Plague Birds_ by Jason Sanford, published by Apex. Nominated for Best Novel in 2021

## 2020

   _Piranesi_ by Susanna Clarke, published by Bloomsbury US and Bloomsbury UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2020
   _The City We Became_ by N.K. Jemisin, published by Orbit US and Orbit UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2020
   _Mexican Gothic_ by Silvia Moreno-Garcia, published by Del Rey and Jo Fletcher. Nominated for Best Novel in 2020
   _The Midnight Bargain_ by C. L. Polk, published by Erewhon. Nominated for Best Novel in 2020
   _Network Effect_ by Martha Wells, published by Tordotcom. Winner, Best Novel in 2020
   _Black Sun_ by Rebecca Roanhorse, published by Saga and Solaris. Nominated for Best Novel in 2020

## 2019

   _Marque of Caine_ by Charles E. Gannon, published by Baen. Nominated for Best Novel in 2019
   _The Ten Thousand Doors of January_ by Alix E. Harrow, published by Redhook. Nominated for Best Novel in 2019
   _A Memory Called Empire_ by Arkady Martine, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2019
   _Gods of Jade and Shadow_ by Silvia Moreno-Garcia, published by Del Rey. Nominated for Best Novel in 2019
   _Gideon the Ninth_ by Tamsyn Muir, published by Tor.com. Nominated for Best Novel in 2019
   _A Song for a New Day_ by Sarah Pinsker, published by Berkley. Winner, Best Novel in 2019

## 2018

   _The Calculating Stars_ by Mary Robinette Kowal, published by Tor. Winner, Best Novel in 2018
   _The Poppy War_ by R. F. Kuang, published by Harper Voyager. Nominated for Best Novel in 2018
   _Blackfish City_ by Sam J. Miller, published by Ecco. Nominated for Best Novel in 2018
   _Spinning Silver_ by Naomi Novik, published by Del Rey. Nominated for Best Novel in 2018
   _Witchmark_ by C. L. Polk, published by Tor.com. Nominated for Best Novel in 2018
   _Trail of Lightning_ by Rebecca Roanhorse, published by Saga Press. Nominated for Best Novel in 2018

## 2017

   _Amberlough_ by Lara Elena Donnelly, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2017
   _The Strange Case of the Alchemist’s Daughter_ by Theodora Goss, published by Saga Press. Nominated for Best Novel in 2017
   _Spoonbenders_ by Daryl Gregory, published by Knopf. Nominated for Best Novel in 2017
   _The Stone Sky_ by N.K. Jemisin, published by Orbit US. Winner, Best Novel in 2017
   _Six Wakes_ by Mur Lafferty, published by Orbit US. Nominated for Best Novel in 2017
   _Jade City_ by Fonda Lee, published by Orbit US. Nominated for Best Novel in 2017
   _Autonomous_ by Annalee Newitz, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2017

## 2016

   _All the Birds in the Sky_ by Charlie Jane Anders, published by Tor. Winner, Best Novel in 2016
   _Borderline_ by Mishell Baker, published by Saga Press. Nominated for Best Novel in 2016
   _The Obelisk Gate_ by N.K. Jemisin, published by Orbit US. Nominated for Best Novel in 2016
   _Ninefox Gambit_ by Yoon Ha Lee, published by Solaris US. Nominated for Best Novel in 2016
   _Everfair_ by Nisi Shawl, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2016

## 2015

   _Ancillary Mercy_ by Ann Leckie, published by Orbit US and Orbit UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2015
   _Barsk: The Elephants’ Graveyard_ by Lawrence M. Schoen, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2015
   _The Fifth Season_ by N.K. Jemisin, published by Orbit US and Orbit UK. Nominated for Best Novel in 2015
   _The Grace of Kings_ by Ken Liu, published by Saga Press. Nominated for Best Novel in 2015
   _Raising Caine_ by Charles E. Gannon, published by Baen. Nominated for Best Novel in 2015
   _Updraft_ by Fran Wilde, published by Tor. Nominated for Andre Norton Nebula Award for Middle Grade and Young Adult Fiction, Best Novel in 2015. Winner, Andre Norton Award for Young Adult Science Fiction and Fantasy 
   _Uprooted_ by Naomi Novik, published by Del Rey. Winner, Best Novel in 2015

## 2014

   _The Goblin Emperor_ by Katherine Addison, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2014
   _Trial By Fire_ by Charles E. Gannon, published by Baen. Nominated for Best Novel in 2014
   _Ancillary Sword_ by Ann Leckie, published by Orbit US. Nominated for Best Novel in 2014
   _The Three-Body Problem_ by Cixin Liu, published by Tor. Nominated for Best Novel in 2014
   _Coming Home_ by Jack McDevitt, published by Ace. Nominated for Best Novel in 2014
   _Annihilation_ by Jeff VanderMeer, published by Farrar, Straus and Giroux. Winner, Best Novel in 2014

## 2013

   _We Are All Completely Beside Ourselves_ by Karen Joy Fowler, published by Marian Wood. Nominated for Best Novel in 2013
   _The Ocean at the End of the Lane_ by Neil Gaiman, published by Morrow and Headline Review. Nominated for Best Novel in 2013
   _Fire With Fire_ by Charles E. Gannon, published by Baen. Nominated for Best Novel in 2013
   _Hild_ by Nicola Griffith, published by Farrar, Straus and Giroux. Nominated for Best Novel in 2013
   _Ancillary Justice_ by Ann Leckie, published by Orbit US and Orbit UK. Winner, Best Novel in 2013
   _The Red: First Light_ by Linda Nagata, published by Mythic Island Press LLC. Nominated for Best Novel in 2013
   _A Stranger in Olondria_ by Sofia Samatar, published by Small Beer. Nominated for Best Novel in 2013
